data.title: Celebrate the Season on the Wild Ten
data.meta_title: Celebrate the Season on the Wild Ten
data.content:
This season, the Wild Ten is alive with celebration! 

Log in for cosmic rewards, limited-time bundles, and join our Discord to showcase your perfect duo for a chance to win 50,000 Salvage.

Whether you’re battling in the Wild Ten or enjoying the seasonal events, it’s a great chance to team up, get creative, and enjoy everything the season has to offer.

Love and Fireworks!

Cosmic fireworks and heartstrings collide!

Log in and complete three battles per day from February 12–20 to claim 5 themed rewards daily, including Salvage, Intel, Decals, Stickers, and a special Wrap. 

Daily Rewards:

  • Day 1: 3,000 Salvage, Love Birds Sticker
  • Day 2: 3,000 Salvage, Foo Dog Decal
  • Day 3: 3,000 Salvage, Peace, Love, Robots Sticker
  • Day 4: 3,000 Salvage, Water Dragon Decal
  • Day 5: 300 Intel, Bubblegum Blast Wrap

How to Participate:

  • Complete your Training Battles to qualify.
  • Play 3 battles and claim rewards as you go.
  • You must receive the previous reward to be eligible for the next one (you can’t skip rewards).

Seasonal Celebrations – Limited-Time Store Offers

Two traditions. One battlefield. Celebrate connection and new beginnings in the Wild Ten with themed bundles available for a limited time.

Hearts of the Wild Ten Bundles

Feathers of Our Love (450 Warp Reals)

Raven has long been favored by pilot pairs who rely on speed and instinct—two minds moving as one before the enemy can react.

  • Raven War Robot
  • x4 Punisher Weapons
  • Emergency Shield Supply Gear
  • Flashbang Cycle Gear
  • Monarch Common Pilot
  • Oracle Common Pilot
  • I Heart This Sticker

Shield of Our Bond (900 Warp Reals)

Ceres earned its reputation escorting veteran duos through impossible odds, proving that some machines are built to protect more than just steel.

  • Ceres War Robot
  • x3 Halo Weapons
  • Ammo Fabricator Supply Gear
  • Reflector Cycle Gear
  • Evolve Common Pilot
  • Prodigy Common Pilot
  • I Heart This Sticker

Salvo of Our Hearts (900 Warp Reals)

Typhon is infamous for synchronized strikes, where perfectly timed salvos from trusted partners decide the battle in seconds.

  • Typhon War Robot
  • x4 Vortex Weapons
  • Kinetic Pulse Supply Gear
  • Nanite Repair Cycle Gear
  • Odyssey
  • Cyclone Joan
  • I Heart This Sticker

Lunar New Year Collection

Welcome the Lunar New Year with festive cosmetics inspired by ancient traditions and legendary dragons.

Dragon Boat Bundle (300 Warp Reals)

  • Dragon Boat Wrap
  • Dragon Head Sticker
  • Zongzi Sticker

The Perfect Duo — Valentine’s Showcase!

This Valentine’s Day, hop onto our Discord and show off your ultimate duo in the #perfect-duo-showcase channel — your favorite War Robot paired with its ideal pilot!

Whether it’s funny, sweet, or epic, share your creation and celebrate the bonds that make your builds shine. Submit your entry before February 18 for a chance to be one of the top 5 winners, who will each receive 50,000 Salvage.

Share the Fight

The Frontier is better with someone you trust at your side. If you’ve got a friend who’s never dropped into War Robots: Frontiers, now’s the perfect time to bring them in.

Send the promocode SENDAVALENTINE to a friend who has never played the game, and they’ll receive:

  • 14-Day Premium Account
  • 14,000 Salvage
  • Raven War Robot
  • Lightnin’ Wrap
  • Oil, Grease & Thunder Sticker
  • Super Ravens Sticker

A solid head start for any new pilot—and a good reason to squad up sooner rather than later.

The promocode is available to new players only until February 22, 09:00 UTC.

Download War Robots: Frontiers for free today:
